summary: StudentDocumentSelector is a user control in the HSPnet Employment Application system that allows staff to select, upload, edit, and manage student documents and web profiles to be attached to employment applications. It supports the workflows required for submitting resumes (anonymous or named), photos, web pages, and other documents, with special business logic to handle various document types including administrative setup errors, consent, and deletion conditions.
purpose: To provide a controlled interface for staff and students to upload, select, edit, and manage documents associated with a student's employment application, with support for business rules, validation, and file storage logic.

workflows.name: Upload and Attach Student Documents
steps: GridView displays available documents; FormView used for editing details.
Staff uploads document via FileUpload control.
Uploaded file is saved on server under a unique folder.
File metadata collected: fileName, fileURL, fileSize, fileType.
System deletes old document if present.
New document is created and saved with all metadata and linked to student.
Business rules applied for document types: resume-anon, resume-named, photo, other.
Special controls and instructions shown depending on document type.
Document type dropdown populated from Codes (StudentDocumentType).
For photo, upload is disabled and consent instructions are shown.
For web profile, only non-blank pages can be added.
Documents can be deleted and removed from the system.
Grid and FormViews are updated after actions (save, delete, edit).
Documents are converted and copied into Employment Application folders.

workflows.name: Profile Web Page Management
steps: Web profile displayed if present and not blank.
Staff can edit web profile information.
Updated web profile details are saved.
Hidden if updated details are blank.

business_rules: Resume-anon, resume-named, photo types have special handling and visibility rules.
If document ID is negative, the dropdown defaults to the corresponding special type.
Staff can only add their own profile web page if not blank.
Document type dropdown is populated only with valid codes.
Removal of special type options from dropdown for ordinary documents.
DeleteAfterDate field handled with radio button logic and visibility dependent on StaffID.
validations: ProfileMode JavaScript variable used for validation of Other comments.
CustomValidator1 and ValidationSummary3 enforce form validation.
Only valid UUIDs and document types are allowed.
FileUpload checks for posted file and content length.
WebPage must not be blank for addition to application.
calculations: DeleteAfterDate parsed from textbox via DateFormatter.
TypeCodeID defaulted/set based on document ID.
conditions: If doc.ID < 0 or matches special type codes, apply special document logic.
If UserSession.StaffID == StudentID, show additional instructions and controls.
If WebPage is blank or WebPageUpdatedDetails is blank, profile controls hidden.
system_behavior: Uploaded files stored in unique folders, path calculated via GUID.
Old document files are deleted before saving new ones.
Documents copied from StudentDocs to EApplicationDocs for employment applications.
Controls and visibility dynamically set based on user session, document type, and conditions.
Redirects after file operations to refresh state.
exceptions: Administrative setup errors if required document codes (RESUME-ANON, RESUME-NAMED, PHOTO) are not found.
Try-catch blocks for code searches and file operations; errors result in hiding controls or informational text.
File not found errors are ignored and shown as disabled controls.
content_gaps: No explicit field-level validation rules for all fields (some implied, some handled via UI controls).
No details on error/warning messages shown to users.
Source does not fully document localization or multi-language support.
Limited documentation on Directory and File management exception handling.
Underlying DataLayer object behaviors and constraints not fully described.
Instructions and business rules are sometimes referenced via Resources, actual texts are not included.
